events.verdict: Carter Jr. (ORL) establishes himself in Reaves' (LAL) path prior to the contact.
Ayton (LAL) is moving alongside Banchero's (ORL) path as he defends the driving shot attempt, and marginal contact occurs with Banchero's right arm.
James (LAL) establishes himself in Banchero's (ORL) path prior to the contact.

da Silva (ORL) is moving alongside Doncic's (LAL) path when Doncic stops and pulls up for a shot attempt. da Silva's momentum carries him forward, and marginal contact occurs as he brushes Doncic off-arm during the shot attempt.
Ayton (LAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Ayton (LAL) places a marginal resting hand on Carter Jr.'s (ORL) side during the jump shot attempt.
Ayton (LAL) makes contact with Carter Jr. (ORL) as he jumps over his back, which impedes Carter Jr's ability to pursue the rebound.
Reaves (LAL) engages with Suggs (ORL) on the perimeter and releases as Suggs moves to set the pick.
Reaves (LAL) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm after his gather, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) is bracing for the contact from Suggs (ORL) as they come together at the end of the drive, and the contact that occurs as Reaves releases away is marginal.
Ayton (LAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

As Ayton (LAL) pursues the ball during the rebound attempt, his left hand makes incidental contact with Suggs (ORL).  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed incidental when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
da Silva (ORL) gets his hand to the ball to begin the dislodge before incidental contact occurs with Ayton's (LAL) arm.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Banchero (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. The Replay Center was able to confirm that the ball touched both players, but there was no clear and conclusive evidence that the last point of contact was to James (LAL), and therefore the call stood.
Banchero (ORL) makes initial hand-on-ball contact, legally blocking the shot and initiating the dislodge before any subsequent incidental contact occurs with James (LAL) during the layup attempt.
Banchero (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Suggs (ORL) and Reaves (LAL) come together after the screen and marginal contact occurs.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Kennard's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) legally contests Suggs' (ORL) jump shot attempt.
